reason: The audit is free, but it still means pulling PO, job and inventory data out of Epicor and handing it to an early-stage company I have never worked with. My IT and legal people would need to sign off on that, and my planners are already stretched, so I don't see this getting done inside 30 days.
objection: Who is this company, what happens to our supplier and job data after the audit, and how much of my team's half-day goes into building the exports?
would_change_my_mind: A written data-handling and deletion commitment that my IT team accepts, plus an export template my planner can run in under an hour.
